constraints.name: idempotency_records_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'reserved'::text AND result_envelope IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL OR status = 'completed'::text AND result_envelope IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: jobs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'leased'::text AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL OR status = 'available'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL OR status = 'completed'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: outbox_events_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: contact_channels_portfolio_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (portfolio_id) REFERENCES portfolio_config.settings(portfolio_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

policies.name: portfolio_channels_application_delete
policies.usingPredicate:
(((portfolio_id)::text = current_setting('shipwithali.portfolio_id'::text, true)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM portfolio_config.settings settings
  WHERE ((settings.portfolio_id = contact_channels.portfolio_id) AND ((settings.owner_id)::text = current_setting('shipwithali.owner_id'::text, true))))))
